description: This file is a configuration script for Playwright testing framework, setting up project-specific test configurations using defineConfig. It includes settings for test directory, retries, reporters, browser projects, and Vite configurations, particularly for component testing with Svelte.

methods.name: defineConfig
methods.description: Defines and exports the Playwright configuration object.

methods.name: devices
methods.description: Provides predefined device configurations for testing on various browsers.
